# History Record 224: Master Integration Plan (Iteration 6) Phase 4: Master Integration, End-to-End Test Suite & Archival

**Date**: 2026-10-16  
**Status**: Completed  
**Scope**: `apps/studio`, `packages/effect-engines`, `autogenerated-tests/`, `docs/`  

---

## 1. Context & Objectives
Phase 4 finalizes **Master Integration Plan (Iteration 6)** by executing comprehensive end-to-end integration testing across all four phases, validating that all acceptance criteria are met, verifying production builds, and completing architectural archival.

Key verification points:
1. **Zero 3D Gizmo Clutter**: Canvas viewport dedicated strictly to 2D vector layouts and staging; all 3D lighting, camera, and particle parameters live in collapsible Sidebar numeric panels.
2. **Interactive In-Canvas 2D Transform Overlay**: 8-point bounding box handles + rotation stem with raycast hit testing and safe-zone magnetic snapping.
3. **Sidebar Deep Inspector Panels**: Collapsible accordions with dual slider/numeric inputs, cinematography color swatches, bypass switches, and undoable modifier removals.
4. **Library Drag-and-Drop Staging**: 12 presets across Text, Shapes, and Partial VFX with cursor $(X, Y)$ drop math and center insert staging.
5. **Inline Canvas Text Editing**: Double-click text cue editing committed to `VideoIR` via `UpdateTextCueCommand` with undo/redo.
6. **Partial Visual Effects Execution**: Three.js localized spotlight cones, scanline glitches, point particle bursts, and frosted blur panels.
7. **Production Build & Parity**: Clean Vite bundle in `apps/studio` with zero native Node.js binary leaks and 100% headless export gizmo suppression.
